GetTableBucketLogging.description: The following example gets the server access logging configuration of a table bucket that has logging enabled.
GetTableBucketLogging.title: To get the server access logging configuration of a table bucket

GetTableBucketLogging.description: The following example gets the server access logging configuration of a table bucket that has logging disabled. The response has an empty logging status.
GetTableBucketLogging.title: To get the server access logging configuration of a table bucket that has logging disabled

PutTableBucketLogging.description: The following example enables server access logging for a table bucket. Logs are delivered to the specified general purpose bucket, with object keys partitioned by the time of the logged events.
PutTableBucketLogging.title: To enable server access logging for a table bucket

PutTableBucketLogging.description: The following example disables server access logging for a table bucket by specifying an empty logging status.
PutTableBucketLogging.title: To disable server access logging for a table bucket
